item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2] Latest src fails to compile zepplin-web due to SLF4J missing class???
item.description:
Right from the mvn build report:
Failed to execute goal com.github.eirslett:frontend-maven-plugin:0.0.20:install-node-and-npm (install node and npm) on project zeppelin-web: Execution install node and npm of goal com.github.eirslett:frontend-maven-plugin:0.0.20:install-node-and-npm failed: A required class was missing while executing com.github.eirslett:frontend-maven-plugin:0.0.20:install-node-and-npm: org/slf4j/helpers/MarkerIgnoringBase

No modifications to the src or to maven...just a git clone and executed maven with the following:
mvn install -DskipTests -Dspark.version=1.2.1 -Dhadoop.version=2.4.0
item.summary: Latest src fails to compile zepplin-web due to SLF4J missing class???

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: This is due to inability to bet NPM dependencies...can successfully build locally
Build server could not fetch NPM and Node dependencies

FYI, to build Zeppelin 1.2.1 you should apply spark-1.2 profile. so you build command should be

mvn install -DskipTests -Pspark-1.2 -Dspark.version=1.2.1 -Dhadoop.version=2.4.0

v0.0.20 seems to have dependency from google code domain. It might be the problem. I have successfully built it with v0.0.23.

Steps to reproduce my solution:
Change the version of plugin in pom.xml of zeppelin-web module

GitHub user seckin206 opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/incubator-zeppelin/pull/10

Updated frontend-maven-plugin to version 0.0.23

Maven fails to retrieve the plugin with v.0.0.20. The plugin v0.0.20 has a dependency from google code domain, that might be the cause. I've updated the plugin to 0.0.23 with no side effects so far.
